summary: Frontend-only testing of the PayRewards Growth Activation Platform refresh on the /business dashboard. Verified landing navbar rebrand ('Sign in' -> 'Log in'), rebuilt login page copy + PayRewards right panel, new sidebar IA with 5 sections + hint labels, workspace switcher, all 5 opportunity cards (each navigates to its target route), 9-stage journey funnel, 6 KPI cards, trend chart, opportunity apply button, Import page dual-column sources (4 conversations + 5 customer feedback) and new success text ('1,521 interactions · 687 reviews imported.'), Interactions page (10 rows, filters, drawer with 4 activation actions), Conversations page (5 sources, 7 cards, signals grid, and status-driven story action buttons for draft/awaiting/approved/empty), Reviews page (12 rows w/ PayRewards personas), Referrals (3 campaigns), Reddit (4 threads across new subreddits), Social Agent generate, and Settings reset workspace (clears localStorage and redirects to /business). All flows pass; no critical console errors.

issues: React hydration warning printed to console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The <select data-testid="social-review-select"> maps REVIEWS -> <option> tags whose text is wrapped by the Emergent build-time source tagger in a <span data-ve-dynamic ...>, which HTML disallows inside <option>. Functionality is unaffected but the warning appears on every /business/social mount.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In SocialAgentPage.jsx the <option> children are dynamic mapped expressions; the Emergent instrumentation adds a wrapper <span> that produces a hydration warning. To silence it, either (a) suppress the warning, (b) pre-compute the label as a plain string variable outside JSX so the tagger doesn't wrap it, or (c) render options via a helper that returns a string literal. Not blocking.

MINOR NAMING: The review request lists KPI ids as interactionsCaptured / conversationsAnalyzed / storiesApproved / reviewCount / avgRating / cacUplift, but InsightsPage.jsx defines KPI_CARDS with ids: interactionsCaptured, storiesApproved, warmIntros, postsPublished, attributedPipeline, cacUplift. Card count matches (6) and all render correctly; only the middle ids differ. Confirm with product whether the requested ids should be renamed or the review checklist should be updated.
critical_code_review_comments: Channel attribution rows have no per-row data-testid — consider adding data-testid="attribution-row-{channel}" so future tests can assert individual rows without brittle text matching.
Interactions summary strip (7 tiles at top of InteractionsPage) does not expose per-tile data-testids; adding data-testid="interactions-tile-{id}" would make QA of tile counts robust.

InsightsPage KPI_CARDS ids (warmIntros/postsPublished/attributedPipeline) diverge from the review-request naming (conversationsAnalyzed/reviewCount/avgRating). Align to avoid future spec/implementation drift.

SocialAgentPage <option> children produce hydration warnings on every mount due to build-time source instrumentation wrapping dynamic option labels in <span>. Refactor option rendering to use plain string labels.

DashboardLayout is 260 lines and healthy; new InteractionsPage (421) and ConversationsPage (562) are acceptable but ConversationsPage is bordering on the split-recommendation threshold — the signals grid + story timeline could each become their own component.
